_comment_purpose: Single source of truth for critical-table classification used by openregs build + delta guards. validate_critical_tables (in scripts/05_build_database.py) uses the `floor` field; weekly_update.sh's snapshot_counts uses the `snapshot` field; weekly_update.sh's validate_delta uses the `growth` field. Adding a new critical table? Add it once here, not in three places.

_comment_fields.floor: Minimum row count below which the build aborts before deploy (validate_critical_tables raises SystemExit(5)). null = no absolute floor; tracked in delta/snapshot only.
_comment_fields.growth: 'incremental' = monotonically grows over time; any drop > 0.1% beyond noise is fatal in the delta guard. 'rebuild' = wiped+repopulated each run (e.g., full eCFR pull, staging-DB import); 5% drop tolerated in delta guard.
_comment_fields.snapshot: true = include in pre/post-build snapshot for delta reporting + delta guard. Tables outside snapshot still get floor coverage if floor is non-null.
_comment_fields.smoke: true = include in post-deploy smoke test (prod row count vs local) in deploy.sh. Keep this small (~5 tables) since each = one HTTPS round-trip to prod. Mirror of 990project/criticality.json field.
_comment_fields.db: Which Datasette database the table lives in. Defaults to 'openregs' if omitted. Set to 'lobbying' for tables in lobbying.db. Only consulted by the post-deploy smoke test to route the curl URL + local file path.

fec_operating_expenditures._note: reclass + floor 15M->12M ride-along (r6: de-arms the 2.4-5% restatement false-abort band).

fec_contributions._note: rebuild-class per FEC-family reclass 2026-07-11. Floor RULED 3.5M (2026-07-11): table flat at 4,395,926 across the 8-build window — the ~50%-of-min doctrine is for tables that move; 3M left a 32% silent-loss window on a 0%-mover, and the floor's only marginal coverage is the DROP/no-baseline case, exactly when the delta guard is absent. 20.4% headroom = real restatement slack. 4M CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: 9% headroom is inside the noise band for a bulk-rebuilt FEC table; a floor that false-aborts on routine restatement becomes a tripwire people learn to override — worse than loose. Do not re-open on that reasoning. on_violation=alert RULED 2026-07-17: FEC restates legitimately, so a blocking floor false-fires on this table's normal behavior and a false abort takes down the weekly deploy — UNDERCOUNT now emits a non-blocking CRITICAL_TABLE_ALERT (routed to op-health: deploys-and-warns); MISSING/UNREADABLE still abort regardless of mode (a restatement can shrink a table, not vanish it — existence stays fail-closed, the 04-19 class).

lobbying_filings_raw._note: Smoke-only entry — table lives in lobbying.db (not openregs.db). lobbying_filings (above) is the imported view in openregs.db that floor + delta + snapshot guards track.

fec_electioneering._note: snapshot:false per r6 — 1,679 rows is below percent-delta usefulness; floor is existence/collapse-only; alert-tier shrink = QC's 1,000 floor.
